Privacy Policy
A Legal Disclaimer

sections.text: We at Štefan Šraga respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you visit our website.

Information We Collect

sections.text: We may collect the following types of information: Personal details (e.g., name, email address, phone number) provided voluntarily through contact forms, newsletter sign-ups, or orders. Technical data (e.g., IP address, browser type, device information) collected automatically through cookies and analytics tools. Transaction data (e.g., billing details, payment information) when you purchase our services/products.
